# Verstela

> > Verstela is a nationwide staffing agency specializing in industrial, warehouse, manufacturing, and technical placements with direct-hire and temp-to-hire solutions.

Verstela connects job seekers with employers across multiple industries through specialized staffing services. The company operates locations in Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Oregon, Tennessee, Texas, and Washington, offering flexible placement options tailored to both temporary and permanent workforce needs.

## Key Topics

- Temp-to-Hire

## Job Seekers

- [Find Jobs](https://www.verstela.com/find-jobs): Job search portal for warehouse, manufacturing, industrial, and technical roles
- [What to Expect](https://www.verstela.com/find-jobs/what-to-expect): Guide to Verstela's job placement process from application to employment
- [Industrial Jobs](https://www.verstela.com/find-jobs/areas-of-expertise/industrial-jobs): Industrial job opportunities including general labor and machine operators
- [Warehouse Jobs](https://www.verstela.com/find-jobs/areas-of-expertise/warehouse-jobs): Warehouse job listings for forklift operators and material handlers
- [Manufacturing Jobs](https://www.verstela.com/find-jobs/areas-of-expertise/manufacturing-jobs): Manufacturing job opportunities for machine operators and production roles
- [Technical and Professional Jobs](https://www.verstela.com/find-jobs/areas-of-expertise/technical-professional-jobs): Technical and professional job placements across multiple industries

- [Technical/Professional Staffing](https://www.verstela.com/for-employer/areas-of-expertise/technical-professional-staffing): Technical and professional staffing including engineering and CMM roles
